plugins.name: ocrdeskew
plugins.description: Repair OCR text layers and produce searchable PDFs with the local OCRDeskew CLI, including parallel batch processing sized to the machine, PDF restriction clearing, and triage of low-confidence results. Runs fully locally with no upload. Free plugin; requires OCRDeskew (20-day trial, then a licence) — see https://ocrdeskew.com.
